name: Zawy
cooked: It appears the solutions are using the timespan limit in the last 3 timestamps to profit. It says there are no solutions as good if it doesn’t let timespan go less than 0.25, so there seems to be a hack on it. The gain from doing it is 932 blocks. Setting every timespan the same costs 4,669 blocks (optimal was 7.12% increase per period).
